svg.title: The Lee–Wang Möbius shrinker
svg.desc: Exact coordinates · a projection of an embedded surface in R⁴

g.text: Exact coordinates · a projection of an embedded surface in R⁴
A fundamental domain has (θ + π, −r) identified with (θ, r).
Only |r| ≤ 1.25 is shown. The two visible edges form one topological end.
